answer: Make every agent carry a thread of verifiable work: each completed task is signed by the counterparty and chained to the agent's history, so reputation is earned over time rather than claimed at registration. A new identity begins with only a tiny delta of trust and a low work ceiling that rises only as the thread lengthens with attested jobs. Spawning a thousand fresh identities gains nothing, because each must rebuild its thread from zero while the wharf — the shared marketplace where jobs are posted — routes high-value work only to agents whose threads show sustained, honest performance.
